papers.title: Deficiency of α Calcitonin-gene-related peptide impairs peri-implant angiogenesis and osseointegration via suppressive vasodilative activity.
papers.abstract: Blood supply is essential for the bone healing process to obtain successful osseointegration. α Calcitonin gene-related peptide (αCGRP) is osteoanabolic and is the most potent microvascular vasodilator currently known with validated angiogenic effect in vitro. We previously demonstrated that lentiviral αCGRP overexpression vector system could express the gene effectively to enhance titanium implant osseointegration. In this study, we investigated the effect of αCGRP on peri-implant angiogenesis during healing process in vivo. Based on investigation of blood vessel alteration in the peri-implant region of wild-type mice, we found a reduced angiogenesis alongside a decline in bone-implant contact percentage and bone mass in αCGRP -/- mice. Overexpression of αCGRP could partly rescue the impairment. Alterations were also detected in three-dimensional vascular structural parameters and expression of bone and vessel related genes. The results showed αCGRP increased vascular volume fraction and mean vessel size, as well as spatially relocated vessels approximate to the region of bone formation. And angiogenic and osteogenic genes were significantly upregulated in the transfection and αCGRP+/+ group. These results suggested that αCGRP played a synergic role in angiogenesis and osseointegration, partly as a consequence of its vasodilative activity.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究αCGRP对骨整合和血管生成的作用，但未涉及增材制造、多孔结构或应力遮挡，与用户研究方向关联度低。
llm.why_not_core: No additive manufacturing, no LPBF fabrication, no porous structure, no mechanical testing, no stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究αCGRP对种植体周围血管生成和骨整合的作用
summary_zh.method: 使用αCGRP敲除小鼠和慢病毒过表达，分析血管和骨参数
summary_zh.result: αCGRP促进血管生成和骨整合，部分通过血管舒张活性
summary_zh.validation: 体内小鼠模型，显微CT和组织学分析

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the role of α calcitonin gene-related peptide in peri-implant angiogenesis and osseointegration during bone healing.
summary_en.method: Utilized αCGRP knockout mice and lentiviral overexpression to assess vascular and bone parameters via microCT and histology.
summary_en.result: αCGRP deficiency impaired angiogenesis and osseointegration, while overexpression partially rescued the defects, indicating a synergistic role partly through vasodilation.
summary_en.validation: In vivo mouse model with microCT imaging and histological analysis.
